name: Lairs & Lost Places
notes: Bosses now sleep in lairs out in the world - wake them at the altar when YOU are ready
About 30 places to discover: camps, ruins, huts, graves, shrines, sunken boats... with loot
Some recipes (iron gear, bow, turret...) are learned by finding them in those places
Die and your backpack stays where you fell - get it back before it's gone
Hunger and thirst last longer; walking is free, SHIFT to sprint
New 3D look: fire light on walls, sun shadows, glow, fog, moving water
Screen & graphics menu: smooth edges, glow effects, sun shadows

history.name: Riverlands
notes: Rivers, bridges, cliffs, roads, fishing, farming, real hills and the Stone Highlands
